summary: Flash CarX full-stack testing (Iteration 1 - first pass). Backend: 30/30 pytest tests passed covering auth, washes CRUD, stats/dashboard, analytics, users search, friend request/accept/reject/remove, ranking (daily/weekly/monthly x earnings/revenue/washes), achievements, feed. Frontend: verified splash→login redirect, register→home flow, login (valid/invalid), Home (Hoje) with earnings hero + stats + add wash bottom sheet + delete wash, Ranking tab (chips + entries), Amigos flow (list→Adicionar Amigo→search 'tester2'→send request→shows 'Pendente'), Profile tab (banner, level/XP, stats grid, menu items, achievements strip), History tab (filters + summary + list), Goals and Settings screens open. Only UX concern: Add Wash bottom sheet's save button lies below the fold on 390x844 viewport — element required scroll_into_view before it was clickable (still clickable via scroll, but not ideal on small phones).

ui_bugs.issue: 'Salvar' button (testID save-wash-button) is rendered below the viewport on 390x844 (iPhone 12/13 mini) and only becomes clickable after scrolling. The bottom sheet content should be wrapped in a ScrollView or the sheet should size responsively / respect keyboard. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (modal section around save-wash-button).

issues: Modal not scrollable / not KeyboardAvoidingView-wrapped; on smaller phones the save button is out of the viewport when keyboard is open.

action_items: (Optional UX) Wrap the Nova Lavagem bottom-sheet body in a ScrollView (or increase max-height / KeyboardAvoidingView) so the 'Salvar Lavagem' button remains visible above the keyboard on smaller devices (390x844).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user correctly excludes _id and password_hash — good.
All Mongo queries in server.py use projection {"_id": 0} — good, no ObjectId leak.
server.py uses env vars for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME with no defaults (fail-fast) — good.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded value; acceptable for preview but should be set via env in production.
Consider adding a POST/GET-only rate limit on /api/auth/register and login (nice-to-have).
Ranking correctly restricts to friends + self (no cross-user leakage).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_flashcarx_api.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/test_flashcarx_api.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`.
